business_overview.one_sentence: Qunabox Group provides AI interactive machine-based marketing services, merchandise sales through vending machines, and IT/software development services mainly in Mainland China.

segments.name: Marketing services
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report p.11 Management Discussion and Analysis

segments.name: Merchandise sales
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report p.11 Management Discussion and Analysis

segments.name: Other services
segments.source: 2025 Annual Report p.11 Management Discussion and Analysis

business_overview.revenue_model: Marketing services are generally paid within 180 days after completion and acceptance; merchandise sales are paid on delivery through vending machines; other services are generally paid within 90 days after completion and acceptance.
business_notes: Trade receivable turnover remained long at 155.6 days in 2025.
The Group mainly operates in the PRC and transactions are mainly settled in RMB.

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value gains on financial assets at FVTPL
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Listed equity investment fair value gain, not operating marketing cash profit.
non_recurring_items.source: 2025 Annual Report p.82 Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Return on cash and deposits, separated from operating profit for owner earnback denominator.
Income from financial assets, separated from operating profit.
Government grant income, not treated as core distributable operating profit.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks and short-term time deposits of one day to three months; RMB1.405739 billion denominated in RMB.

funds_assets.item: Current listed equity investments at FVTPL
funds_assets.business_substance: Hong Kong listed equity securities measured at fair value; liquid but price-risk asset.

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables from marketing service customers; credit terms generally three to six months.
Fast-moving consumer goods inventory for vending-machine merchandise sales.

operating_assets.item: Prepayments, deposits and other receivables - current
operating_assets.business_substance: Prepayments to suppliers/service providers and lease deposits/receivables.
Mainly AI interactive terminals and transport equipment.
Office premises and warehouses used in operations.

investment_assets.item: Non-current unlisted equity investment at FVTPL
investment_assets.business_substance: 10.53% interest in Shandong Sofine Food Technology; not equity-accounted.

other_assets.source: 2025 Annual Report p.83 Consolidated Statement of Financial Position

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Current unpledged bank loans, effective interest rate 2.63%-3.80%, maturity 2026.
Operating leases for office premises and warehouses; not deducted as acquisition debt in main cash pool, reflected in profit/cash quality.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Payables for merchandise and services, normally settled in 30 to 60 days.
Equipment payables, salary payables, taxes, outsourcing service fees and accruals.

other_liabilities.source: 2025 Annual Report p.83 Consolidated Statement of Financial Position

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deferred tax liabilities after presentation offset.
other_liabilities.source: 2025 Annual Report p.83 and p.129 note 16

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow covered reported profit, but the company has only two listed annual cash-flow years in this pack, trade receivables are large with 155.6 turnover days and RMB89.363 million ECL allowance. Main denominator should therefore be discounted despite positive 2025 cash conversion.

evidence.business_substance: HKEXnews 2025 annual report PDF and local text conversion.
The Group disclosed no pledged assets as at December 31, 2025.
evidence.source: 2025 Annual Report p.17 Management Discussion and Analysis

evidence.business_substance: The Group disclosed no material contingent liabilities as at December 31, 2025.
evidence.source: 2025 Annual Report p.17 Management Discussion and Analysis

gaps: The annual report does not split cash between Cayman/Hong Kong holding companies and Mainland operating subsidiaries.
The annual report does not disclose restricted cash as a separate balance; no pledge of assets is disclosed, but bank account-level restrictions were not separately proven.
Only 2024 and 2025 full cash-flow statement details are available in this annual report; 2023 cash-flow details were not extracted from a separate prospectus or prior filing.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not explicitly split; PPE additions and cash purchases of PPE are both recorded as evidence.
